panels.title: Strategy Standings Leaderboard (Ranked by Cash & Realized PnL)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.participant_id,
    s.experiment_id,
    s.strategy_id,
    s.display_label,
    ROUND(s.cash_dollars, 2) AS cash_dollars,
    ROUND(s.realized_pnl_dollars, 2) AS realized_pnl,
    ROUND((s.cash_dollars - e.start_balance) / e.start_balance * 100.0, 2) AS roi_pct,
    s.trades,
    s.wins,
    s.losses,
    ROUND(s.win_rate_pct, 1) AS win_rate_pct,
    e.status AS cohort_status
FROM strategy_standings s
JOIN strategy_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR s.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR s.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$experiment_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$experiment_status')
  AND s.trades >= CAST('$min_trades' AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY s.cash_dollars DESC, s.realized_pnl_dollars DESC;

panels.title: Normalized Rolling ROI % (Eliminating Early-Starter Compounding Bias)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.strategy_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cohorts,
    ROUND(AVG((s.cash_dollars - e.start_balance) / e.start_balance * 100.0), 2) AS mean_roi_pct,
    ROUND(MIN((s.cash_dollars - e.start_balance) / e.start_balance * 100.0), 2) AS min_roi_pct,
    ROUND(MAX((s.cash_dollars - e.start_balance) / e.start_balance * 100.0), 2) AS max_roi_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.cash_dollars > e.start_balance THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_profitable_cohorts,
    SUM(s.trades) AS total_trades,
    ROUND(SUM(s.realized_pnl_dollars), 2) AS total_realized_pnl
FROM strategy_standings s
JOIN strategy_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$experiment_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$experiment_status')
  AND s.trades >= CAST('$min_trades' AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY s.strategy_id
ORDER BY mean_roi_pct DESC;

panels.title: Strategy Family Win Rate & Performance Comparison

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s.strategy_id,
    ROUND(AVG(s.win_rate_pct), 1) AS avg_win_rate_pct,
    SUM(s.trades) AS total_trades,
    SUM(s.wins) AS total_wins,
    SUM(s.losses) AS total_losses,
    ROUND(SUM(s.realized_pnl_dollars), 2) AS net_pnl_dollars
FROM strategy_standings s
JOIN strategy_experiments e ON s.participant_id = e.participant_id AND s.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR s.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR s.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR s.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$experiment_status' = 'all' OR e.status = '$experiment_status')
GROUP BY s.strategy_id
ORDER BY avg_win_rate_pct DESC;

SELECT
    t.closed_at_ms AS time,
    t.strategy_id AS metric,
    SUM(t.pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY t.participant_id, t.strategy_id ORDER BY t.closed_at_ms ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_pnl
FROM strategy_trades t
WHERE t.closed_at_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
ORDER BY t.closed_at_ms ASC;

SELECT
    t.strategy_id,
    COALESCE(t.exit_reason, 'unsettled') AS exit_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS trade_count,
    ROUND(SUM(t.pnl), 2) AS total_pnl,
    ROUND(AVG(t.pnl), 2) AS avg_pnl
FROM strategy_trades t
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
GROUP BY t.strategy_id, exit_reason
ORDER BY t.strategy_id ASC, trade_count DESC;
